newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total says lot of progress in Iran talks.
newsitem.headline: Total says lot of progress in Iran talks.

text.p: French oil group Total has "made a lot of progress" in talks with Iran on developing the South Pars gas field and the investment in the project would be around two billion dollars, chairman Thierry Demarest said on Wednesday.
"We have made a lot of progress in the talks with Iran on the development of the offshore natural gas field in the South Pars zone," he told an Total annual shareholders meeting.
"The investment would be on a scale of around two billion dollars," he said.
Total's involvement would be in the context of a joint venture with other partners, he added.
Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayat said in Tehran last Sunday that the planned project showed that U.S. sanctions were having no impact on his country.
